subject: Request: Permission to use Nimbus logo & customer quote in customer spotlight
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Reddy <samir.reddy@nimbusanalytics.com>
Cc: nina.park@nimbusanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Customer spotlight: permission to use Nimbus logo & short quote

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. We put together a short customer spotlight that highlights how Nimbus reduced inference costs by switching to Redwood Dedicated. The current draft is attached (spotlight_draft.docx).

Request: would Nimbus be comfortable with Redwood publishing this as a short web case study and social post that includes:
- Nimbus logo (display + high-res download)
- A 1–2 sentence customer quote pulled from your feedback (we've proposed a draft below)

Draft quote we planned to use: "Nimbus has cut inference costs by 45% while improving latency for our analytics pipeline. Redwood made the transition seamless."

If you'd prefer a different phrasing, or if legal/comms need to review, totally fine — please let me know. If you can share a high-res logo and the name/email of the person who can sign off, we can move to a final draft quickly.

Attachments: spotlight_draft.docx (draft case study)

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192
From: Samir Reddy <samir.reddy@nimbusanalytics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Park <nina.park@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer spotlight: permission to use Nimbus logo & short quote

Hi Neha —

Appreciate the draft. In principle Nimbus is happy to be featured — the story looks good. A couple of quick asks:
1) Can we soften the quote to avoid exact percentage if possible? Legal prefers language that is less specific unless we've tracked the exact baseline. Could we change to: "Nimbus reduced per-inference costs substantially while improving latency for our analytics pipeline."
2) Attaching our brand artwork (Nimbus_logo_rgb.png) for web use.

I'll loop in our legal counsel if they want to sign any standard permission language; otherwise Nina (cc'd) will be our final approver from comms.

Attaching: Nimbus_logo_rgb.png

Best,
Samir
VP of Product
Nimbus Analytics
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Customer spotlight: permission to use Nimbus logo & short quote

Laura / Marissa —

Forwarding Samir's note. Nimbus is okay in principle and they attached their logo. They asked that we soften the quote language. Can Comms (Laura) confirm the suggested copy looks publishable? Legal (Marissa) — would you review quickly and either sign our standard customer permission or propose the redline?

Goal: get a single signed permission copy + high-res logo so we can publish the case study and a short LinkedIn post next week.

Link to draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2bNIMBUS-spotlight-draft

Thanks — I can make the quote edit once you give the OK.

—Neha
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Customer spotlight: permission to use Nimbus logo & short quote

Neha —

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the draft and Samir's requested tweak; we should avoid publishing percentages unless the customer supplies a written metric they warrant. The softened quote Samir suggested is acceptable.

I've attached a short permission template with a minor redline to make the usage window explicit (12 months) and to require attribution to Nimbus when using the quote in paid media. See redline_agreement.pdf.

If Nimbus signs that, Comms can proceed. Laura, please review the copy below and confirm it's aligned with Redwood voice.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redline_agreement.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Reddy <samir.reddy@nimbusanalytics.com>
Cc: Nina Park <nina.park@nimbusanalytics.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer spotlight: permission to use Nimbus logo & short quote

Hi Samir / Nina —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the logo. Per Marissa's note, we've updated the quote to the softened language below and attached the permission template for signature. If you could confirm the final quote and sign the permission, we can schedule the publish for next Wednesday.

Updated quote: "Nimbus reduced per-inference costs substantially while improving latency for our analytics pipeline."

Permission template (attached) highlights: 12-month usage window; attribution required for paid placements. If that's acceptable, please sign and return redline_agreement.pdf.

I've also shared the live draft doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2bNIMBUS-spotlight-draft (comment access enabled).

Next steps:
- Nina to sign permission or request edits (by EOD tomorrow)
- Marissa to confirm legal text is final after their sign-off
- Redwood to schedule final QA and publish

Thanks,
Neha
From: Samir Reddy <samir.reddy@nimbusanalytics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Park <nina.park@nimbusanalytics.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer spotlight: permission to use Nimbus logo & short quote

Neha / team —

Confirming Nimbus signs off. Nina has reviewed the draft and the updated quote reads fine. We've signed the permission (attached signed_redline_agreement.pdf — same file name as before with signature) and approve use of our Nimbus_logo_rgb.png in the case study and social posts; attribution for paid placements is accepted.

Please credit: Nimbus Analytics (www.nimbusanalytics.com)

Samir
VP of Product
Nimbus Analytics
Attachment: signed_redline_agreement.pdf
